lines.text: Many learners say: I have two child.
Child has a special plural: children.

data.why: Child has a special plural: children.

native.hook: two child、複数形が抜けてない？
native.tip: 2つ以上なら複数形。child の複数形は children（childs ではない）。
native.caption: “I have two child.”と言っていませんか？😅 数が2以上のときは名詞を複数形にします。child は特別で children になります。 “I have two children.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“books”。数が2以上なら名詞は複数形。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Is your plural missing in “two child”?
en.tip: With two or more, use the plural. Child becomes children.
en.caption: Do you say “I have two child.”? 😅 With two or more, the noun must be plural. Child is special: children. The natural way is “I have two children.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
